construction.nested_sequence: canonical gold answer strings ordered once; each fidelity state is a longer prefix
construction.minimum_correct_answer_count_formula: ceil(tau*n/(2-tau)) under set-F1 with no false positives
construction.source_backed_control: concatenated exact source proof for the same answer prefix

logical_conclusion.proved: A compact nested sequence in the Target native vocabulary exists for every audited query and is much shorter than V8. Thus the joint compactness/nesting/symbol-compatibility constraints are not mathematically inconsistent.
not_proved: Qwen3-8B will copy or use this code under the frozen QA prompt
a compressor can infer the code without gold answers
the code is faithful/source-grounded when generated automatically
end-to-end compute Pareto after code construction
logical_conclusion.anti_cheating: The construction uses gold answers and is an existence witness only. It is prohibited as a deployable compressor or training input.
